title: Loot & Explore's Staffs/Staves fix
description: Simply allows Loot & Explore's staffs/staves to cast the default spell from the RPG Series Wizards & Paladins mods. Requires the Item Components mod.
body:
For unknown reasons, Staves added by the **LNE Wizards Add-On** & **LNE Paladins & Priests Add-On** mods does not have the default spell assigned to the RPG Series **Wizards**'s staves and **Paladins & Priests**'s holy staves, those being 'Arcane Blast', 'Pyroblast', 'Frost Bolt' and 'Holy Shock'. This makes upgrading the staves into those added by the former mods _a scam_, so I made a datapack that changes the default components of these staves, completely unaffected by enchantments, tiers/modifiers or power levels added by the **Dungeon Difficulty** mod.

# Before:
![no default spell](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/49ddc907fccf8d20f63390952e84d2d3281d66f6.png)

# After:
![allows casting 'Arcane Blast' as intended](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a6ceb6b0ada0077a74b8d5eeb3966fee8bab960.png)
